payload.text: Cosmopolitan: Most Thoughtful Valentine's Day Gifts for Couples - Interactive adventure scratch-off books ($20-$35), matching touch bracelets, and custom constellation star maps ($30-$55) lead Valentine sales over traditional flowers.

Retail Dive: Valentine's Day Consumer Spending Trends - Last-minute shoppers create huge conversion spikes 7-10 days before Feb 14. Free expedited shipping and bundled gift sets see highest cart conversion.
